description: Durable, scoped agent memory. Read/written by the memory search/write API and injected by the dispatcher. Keyword/full-text retrieval in v1; a nullable embedding field can be added later without a migration.

fields.label: Memory Scope
fields.description: Agent = one BPMN agent element; Process = one process model; Entity = one business document

fields.label: Agent Element
fields.description: The BPMN element id (e.g. Activity_1a2b3c). Required for Agent scope.

fields.label: Process
fields.description: The process model this memory is scoped to (required for Process scope) or, for Agent scope, the process the writing run belonged to (optional provenance, not a scope key).

fields.label: Reference Doctype
fields.description: The business document type this memory is about (e.g. Customer). Required for Entity scope.

fields.label: Reference Name
fields.description: The specific business document this memory is about. Required for Entity scope.

fields.label: Content
fields.description: The memory text — the single source of truth for v1 keyword search. ignore_xss_filter is required here: without it, Frappe's core save-time sanitizer (Document._sanitize_content, bleach-based) treats any '<...>'-shaped substring as an unrecognized HTML tag and HTML-escapes it (observed live: a '<PROJECT>-<YEAR>-<SEQ>' naming convention was stored as '<PROJECT>-...' verbatim) — this field holds arbitrary plain text, not markup, and must round-trip unchanged.
How much this fact matters when it competes for recall, 1 (minor) to 5 (critical). Set by the distiller; a higher value lifts the memory in ranking.
fields.label: Importance
Dedup Key
fields.description: Optional. When set, a write with the same scope + scope keys + dedup_key overwrites the existing record instead of inserting a new one.

fields.label: User Directed
fields.description: Set when a user explicitly asked the agent to remember this (e.g. "remember that..."). Written verbatim, bypassing the salience distiller, and exempt from Log Settings auto-cleanup and keyword-only recall.

fields.label: Source Run
fields.description: The AI Agent Run that wrote this memory, when written by an agent.

Where the fact came from. A User Statement is something a person said or asked for; an Agent Inference is the agent's own conclusion; a Tool Output is read off data a tool returned. The trust hierarchy on Processa Settings decides which wins a contradiction.
fields.label: Source Type
fields.options:
User Statement
Agent Inference
Tool Output

fields.description: How sure the store is of this fact, 0 to 1. Starts from the source type, rises when a later fact corroborates it, and decays with age when compared.
fields.label: Confidence
Expires On
fields.description: Optional per-record expiry, independent of Log Settings retention.

name: AI Memory
